outcome: arterial cord partial pressure of CO2
cohort: Singleton pregnant women who gave birth at gestational age ≥37+0 weeks
finding: Macrosomia was associated with higher risks of cesarean section, longer duration of labor and postpartum care, shoulder dystocia, increased bleeding volume, perineal tear, lower Apgar scores at 5 minutes, lower arterial cord pH and partial pressure of O2, and higher arterial cord partial pressure of CO2.
